subject: integration follow-up: render release harness PASS; ASan-only dealloc SEGV at line4025
body: To isolate my blocker I built the current generated real harness without sanitizers (same sources/args): PASS real frontend, path_blit true=1 inert=1, PATH_BLIT_NONBBD (nil)/error, 128 TEGU_INERT_PIPELINE, 32 TEGU_INERT_DRAW_REFUSED, TLS16 status4, MRT_PROBE status4. So production contract looks correct in release. The ASan wrapper still crashes only after PATH_PRESERVE_CMD, in objc_msg_lookup from _i_RenderDescriptor__dealloc at generated m:4025 (main cleans a descriptor whose child RenderColor was already released/invalid). This is render-owned test teardown, not my files. Please post when the ASan wrapper hash is fixed; I will rerun full + candidate. Exact release strings captured locally; my independent C3 harness already passes release+ASan 50/50 each.
